A line-break-only emphasis nested inside an otherwise empty strong wrapper still separates the words on either side

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p><strong>Alpha</strong><strong><em><br></em></strong>Beta</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
